EmailTemplate.name: WG OTP Verification Code
EmailTemplate.subject: Verify your email address for Wadhwani Grants
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Pwdless_New_User.FirstName},
Thank you for signing up with Wadhwani Grants. Enter the code below where prompted to confirm your email address.
Verification code: {!Verification_Code}
For your security, do not share this code with anyone. The Wadhwani Grants team will never ask you for it.
If you did not try to sign up or sign in to Wadhwani Grants, you can ignore this email.
Kind regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
